title: Cocktail Advent Calendar – 24 Acrylic Cocktail Bottles
seo_description: A new cocktail bottle to hang up every day until Christmas Eve – 24 different names, from Martini to Negroni.
descriptionHtml:
Adults rarely get an advent calendar of their own

Chocolate calendars and Christmas tree ornaments with elves are made for kids, not for someone who'd rather talk cocktails than gingerbread. Anyone who wants to decorate the home bar or the Christmas tree with something that matches their interest in drinks has to search long in ordinary Christmas shops. What's left is the same mulled wine theme as last year.

A cocktail calendar, not a kids' calendar

The calendar box's 24 numbered doors go with 24 flat acrylic cocktail bottles – Martini, Mojito, Negroni and more names printed on each one. Each has a small metal loop, so they go straight up on the tree, the window or the home bar. Completely alcohol-free: it's pure decoration, nothing to drink, so it works as well as office decor as it does at home in the living room.

What you get

  • A new cocktail bottle to hang up every day until Christmas Eve – 24 different names, from Martini to Negroni.
  • The calendar lives on after Christmas: the bottles can be taken out and hung up again next December.
  • Works just as well at work, in the home bar or in the Christmas tree at home – no chocolate to scatter around.
  • Completely alcohol-free, so it can be given away without wondering who gets to drink what.
  • Calendar box with 24 numbered doors (1–24), approx. 26 × 18 × 3 cm.
  • 24 flat acrylic cocktail bottles (2D), each with a metal loop for hanging.
  • Printed cocktail names, including Martini, Mojito, Negroni and Manhattan.
  • Total weight 100 g. No drinkable contents – pure decoration.

Frequently asked questions

Does the calendar contain alcohol or real miniature bottles?
No. The 24 bottles are acrylic decorations, with no opening or contents – the whole calendar weighs just 100 grams, which doesn't add up with filled bottles. This is decoration, not a drink.

What are the bottles made of?
Acrylic (2D acrylic according to the supplier), flat with a small metal loop at the top so they can be hung on a tree, in a window or on a shelf.

How do the doors work?
The box has 24 numbered doors (1–24), one per day until Christmas Eve, linked to the 24 bottles. We can't confirm exactly how the opening mechanism works from the product sheet.

Which cocktails are included?
The labels we can read show, among others, Martini, Margarita, Mojito, Old Fashioned, Cosmopolitan, Mai Tai, Espresso Martini, Gin & Tonic, Piña Colada, Rum Punch, Tom Collins, Negroni, Whiskey Sour and Manhattan. All 24 bottles have a printed cocktail name, but we can't guarantee exactly which 24 come with your calendar.

Is there an age limit?
No, no age rating is printed on the packaging – the calendar is made for adults given the cocktail theme, not for children.

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
